beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meta-rationality names the ability to examine the systems through which we reason.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explores why evidence alone cannot choose every purpose for us.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A medical decision can involve survival, family burdens, and a person’s own priorities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those concerns do not always fit into one agreed measure of success.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Expert knowledge remains necessary, while the decision also requires situated judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader is invited to notice where different models illuminate different concerns.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Wisdom here involves relating knowledge to uncertainty, consequence, and the people affected.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The following correction asks what keeps such reflection from becoming endless postponement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Recognizing every frame can become another way of avoiding a difficult decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explicitly challenges that comfortable misuse of intellectual humility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Someone may benefit while everyone else waits for another layer of analysis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Likewise, acknowledging perspective cannot make every claim equally protected from criticism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Outfinitism proposes acting within declared limits while preserving a credible route to correction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model should state what could make it lose authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is the book’s practical tension between decisive action and revisable judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its philosophy must face the same test as the institutions it examines.
